lessons.name: First Impressions
lessons.description: Idioms for describing people, and the present perfect for experiences.

multiple_choice.name: Match the character idioms
pairs: To be good with your hands
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to its Bulgarian idiom.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A good impression
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той ми направи добро __ още на първата среща.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той ми направи добро впечатление още на първата среща." means "He made a good impression on me at our very first meeting." The fixed phrase is "правя впечатление".

true_false.name: True or false: Imam zab
true_false.sentence: "Имам зъб на някого" means "I have a toothache because of someone".
true_false.explanation: It means "I hold a grudge against someone".

fill_in_the_blank.name: I have never met
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Никога не съм __ толкова приятелски настроен човек.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Никога не съм срещал толкова приятелски настроен човек." means "I have never met such a friendly person." The present perfect is съм + the -л participle.

true_false.name: True or false: Present perfect
true_false.sentence: The present perfect ("съм срещал") is made from "съм" plus the past active participle.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The participle agrees with the subject: срещал, срещала, срещали.

multiple_choice.name: Match the character adjectives
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A person who helps
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тя е човек, __ винаги помага на другите.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тя е човек, който винаги помага на другите." means "She is a person who always helps others." The relative pronoun agrees with човек, which is masculine.

lessons.name: Biographies
lessons.description: The renarrative mood: telling what you heard rather than what you saw.

multiple_choice.name: Match witnessed and reported
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English description to the Bulgarian verb form.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I was not at the concert
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не бях на концерта, но той __ страхотен.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не бях на концерта, но той бил страхотен." means "I was not at the concert, but apparently it was great." You did not witness it, so the renarrative бил fits.

true_false.name: True or false: Renarrative mood
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian has special verb forms for events the speaker did not witness.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The renarrative mood (преизказно наклонение) marks information as reported, not seen.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Once upon a time
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имало едно време един цар, който __ три дъщери.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имало едно време един цар, който имал три дъщери." means "Once upon a time there was a king who had three daughters." Fairy tales are told in the renarrative, and the story keeps to it.

true_false.name: True or false: Zavarshil
true_false.sentence: "Завършил е медицина." means he dropped out of medical school.
true_false.explanation: It means he graduated in medicine. Завършвам means "to finish" or "to graduate".

multiple_choice.name: Match the reported be
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to the renarrative form of "съм".

fill_in_the_blank.name: He has lived in Sofia
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той е роден в Габрово, но е __ целия си живот в София.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той е роден в Габрово, но е живял целия си живот в София." means "He was born in Gabrovo but has lived all his life in Sofia." After е you need the -л participle.

lessons.name: Generations
lessons.description: Family across generations, the pluperfect and unreal conditions.

multiple_choice.name: Match the generation words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: She had already cooked
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Когато пристигнахме, баба вече __ обяда.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Когато пристигнахме, баба вече беше сготвила обяда." means "When we arrived, grandma had already cooked lunch." The earlier of two past events takes the pluperfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Ako byah znael
true_false.sentence: "Ако бях знаел, щях да дойда." means "If I had known, I would have come."
true_false.explanation: Correct. The pluperfect after ако plus щях да makes a past unreal condition.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I would call more often
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако имах повече време, __ по-често на родителите си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако имах повече време, бих се обаждал по-често на родителите си." means "If I had more time, I would call my parents more often."

true_false.name: True or false: Prilicham
true_false.sentence: "Приличам на баща си." means "I like my father."
true_false.explanation: It means "I look like my father". "Харесвам" is "to like".

multiple_choice.name: Match the values
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I were younger
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ по-млад, бих учил отново.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако бях по-млад, бих учил отново." means "If I were younger, I would study again." An unreal condition takes the past бях.

lessons.name: Busy Lives
lessons.description: Time management, verbal nouns in -не and pairs of imperfective and perfective verbs.

multiple_choice.name: Match the aspect pairs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each imperfective verb with its perfective partner.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Ordering tasks
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ на задачите по важност спестява време.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Подреждането на задачите по важност спестява време." means "Ordering tasks by importance saves time." The verbal noun подреждане acts as the subject.

true_false.name: True or false: Otlagam
true_false.sentence: "Отлагам" means "to put off" or "to postpone".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Не отлагай за утре това, което можеш да направиш днес."

fill_in_the_blank.name: All morning
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Цяла сутрин __ на имейли и не успях да свърша нищо друго.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Цяла сутрин отговарях на имейли..." means "All morning I was answering emails..." An activity over a stretch of time takes the imperfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Verbal nouns
true_false.sentence: Verbal nouns ending in -не, like "четене", are feminine.
true_false.explanation: They are neuter: четенето, писането, подреждането.

multiple_choice.name: Match the productivity words
pairs: баланс между работата и личния живот
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I read three chapters
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Докато чаках влака, __ три глави от книгата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Докато чаках влака, прочетох три глави от книгата." means "While I was waiting for the train, I read three chapters." A finished, counted result takes the perfective.

lessons.name: The Housing Market
lessons.description: Buying property, mortgages and past passive participles.

multiple_choice.name: Match the property words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Fully furnished
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Апартаментът е напълно __ и готов за нанасяне.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Апартаментът е напълно обзаведен и готов за нанасяне." means "The flat is fully furnished and ready to move into." Обзаведен is a past passive participle.

true_false.name: True or false: Postroena
true_false.sentence: "Сградата е построена през 2010 г." means "The building was built in 2010."
true_false.explanation: Correct. Съм + a past passive participle makes the passive.

fill_in_the_blank.name: VAT included
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Цената __ ДДС.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Цената включва ДДС." means "The price includes VAT."

true_false.name: True or false: Tuhlena kooperatsiya
true_false.sentence: "Тухлена кооперация" is a wooden house in a village.
true_false.explanation: It is a brick-built block of flats, usually older and smaller than the prefabricated panel blocks.

multiple_choice.name: Match the moving verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The building was insulated
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сградата беше __ миналата година и сега е по-топла.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сградата беше санирана миналата година..." means "The building was insulated last year and is now warmer." The passive needs the past passive participle.

lessons.name: Hospitality and Etiquette
lessons.description: Negative questions as invitations, negative commands and everyday reactions.

multiple_choice.name: Match the reactions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English reaction to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Stay a bit longer
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Няма ли да __ още малко? Рано е!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Няма ли да останеш още малко? Рано е!" means "Won't you stay a little longer? It's early!" A negative question makes a warm invitation.

true_false.name: True or false: Nodding
true_false.sentence: Traditionally in Bulgaria, nodding the head up and down means "no", and shaking it means "yes".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Many younger Bulgarians use both gestures, so listen for "да" and "не" as well.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Do not worry about the dishes
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не се __ за чиниите, ние ще ги измием.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не се безпокойте за чиниите, ние ще ги измием." means "Don't worry about the dishes, we will wash them." A negative command takes the imperfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Negative imperative
true_false.sentence: A negative command usually takes the perfective aspect: "Не затвори вратата!"
true_false.explanation: A negative command normally takes the imperfective: "Не затваряй вратата!"

multiple_choice.name: Match the exclamations
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English exclamation to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Do not be shy
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Не се __ и се чувствайте като у дома си!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Не се стеснявайте и се чувствайте като у дома си!" means "Don't be shy, make yourselves at home!" A negative command takes the imperfective.

lessons.name: Workplace Communication
lessons.description: Formal letters, set phrases and the passive with "бъда".

multiple_choice.name: Match the letter phrases
pairs: I look forward to your reply
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Thank you for the reply
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ Ви за бързия отговор.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Благодаря Ви за бързия отговор." means "Thank you for the quick reply."

true_false.name: True or false: Capital Vie
true_false.sentence: In a formal Bulgarian letter to one person, "Вие" and "Ви" are written with a capital letter.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The capital letter shows respect to the reader.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Must be finished
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Проектът трябва да бъде __ до края на месеца.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Проектът трябва да бъде завършен до края на месеца." means "The project must be finished by the end of the month."

true_false.name: True or false: Komandirovka
true_false.sentence: "Командировка" means "a promotion".
true_false.explanation: A командировка is a business trip. A promotion is "повишение".

multiple_choice.name: Match the email terms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Please send the documents
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Моля, __ ни необходимите документи до петък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Моля, изпратете ни необходимите документи до петък." means "Please send us the necessary documents by Friday." A single request takes the perfective command.

lessons.name: Environment and Science
lessons.description: Climate and pollution, and abstract nouns built with -ост and -ство.

multiple_choice.name: Match the environment words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Sorting waste
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Все повече хора __ отпадъците си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Все повече хора разделят отпадъците си." means "More and more people sort their waste." Хора is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Suffix -ost
true_false.sentence: The suffix -ост makes abstract nouns from adjectives: "устойчив" becomes "устойчивост".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Устойчив means "sustainable", so устойчивост is "sustainability".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Cut emissions in half
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако до 2030 г. не __ емисиите наполовина, климатът ще продължи да се затопля.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако до 2030 г. не намалим емисиите наполовина..." means "If we do not cut emissions in half by 2030..." A single result by a deadline takes the perfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Susha
true_false.sentence: "Суша" means "flood".
true_false.explanation: "Суша" means "drought", and also "dry land". A flood is "наводнение".

multiple_choice.name: Match the environment verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Forests must be protected
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Горите трябва да бъдат __ от пожари.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Горите трябва да бъдат опазени от пожари." means "Forests must be protected from fires."

lessons.name: Climate and Seasons
lessons.description: Predictions, hedging and the future in the past with "щеше да".

multiple_choice.name: Match the hedges
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: It was going to rain
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Синоптиците казаха, че __ да вали, но беше слънчево цял ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Синоптиците казаха, че щеше да вали..." means "The forecasters said it was going to rain..." A future seen from the past takes щеше да.

true_false.name: True or false: Edva li
true_false.sentence: "Едва ли ще завали." means "It will definitely rain."
true_false.explanation: It means "It is unlikely to rain". Едва ли expresses doubt.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Raining heavily
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вали като из __ цял ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вали като из ведро цял ден." means "It has been pouring all day", literally "raining as if from a bucket".

true_false.name: True or false: Uzh
true_false.sentence: "Уж е лято, а е студено." means "It's supposedly summer, but it's cold."
true_false.explanation: Correct. Уж casts doubt on what follows.

multiple_choice.name: Match the extreme weather
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We would have gone out
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако не беше валяло, __ на разходка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако не беше валяло, щяхме да излезем на разходка." means "If it had not rained, we would have gone for a walk."

lessons.name: Heritage and Holidays
lessons.description: National holidays, cultural heritage and the passive voice.

multiple_choice.name: Match the national holidays
pairs: Ден на българската просвета и култура
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each date to the Bulgarian name of the holiday.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Cyrillic was created
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кирилицата е __ в края на IX век.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кирилицата е създадена в края на IX век." means "The Cyrillic alphabet was created at the end of the 9th century."

true_false.name: True or false: 3 March
true_false.sentence: On 3 March Bulgaria celebrates its liberation from Ottoman rule in 1878.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is the national day, marking the Treaty of San Stefano.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the UNESCO list
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Рилският манастир е __ в списъка на ЮНЕСКО.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Рилският манастир е включен в списъка на ЮНЕСКО." means "The Rila Monastery is included in the UNESCO list."

true_false.name: True or false: Unification Day
true_false.sentence: Unification Day on 6 September marks the union of Bulgaria with Macedonia.
true_false.explanation: It marks the union of the Principality of Bulgaria with Eastern Rumelia in 1885.

multiple_choice.name: Match the heritage sites
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Famous for its murals
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Боянската църква е известна със __ си от XIII век.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Боянската църква е известна със стенописите си от XIII век." means "Boyana Church is famous for its 13th-century murals." With си the noun takes the article.
